The variety of textures, colors, and crystal formations makes this a fun starter set or an interesting addition to any existing collection. The tan geode with white crystals has an irregular opening and rough outer shell with some small chips. The smaller grey and white crystal geode halves have cleanly broken edges, rough outer surfaces, and intact sparkling crystal interiors. The additional crystal clusters and clear mineral piece are irregularly shaped with rough fractured surfaces. The iridescent purple mineral piece shows uneven coloration and natural texture. The small metal hammer shows finish wear, minor scuffs, and light scratching on the head and handle with some discoloration but no major damage.
